fusions.name: Stalker's Mile
fusions.desc: Strikes a target you have followed, up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Pinning Heel
fusions.desc: Stamps a clawed foot down on the target and deals 5 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 20% chance to hold it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Burning Stride
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Step Mends
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
